findings: Current catalog note already contains relevant prior research, which was reviewed and preserved. No catalog edits made.

Groth's live product and visually inspected cover confirm General Music Publishing GEN823, Concerto for Alto Saxophone and String Orchestra, recital version with piano reduction. Gallery exposes only the cover, so solo notation remains uninspected.

AFM Local 802's obituary states the concerto was written for and recorded by Harvey Estrin. A contemporary December 1967 Billboard report names Estrin with Stuttgart Philharmonia strings, establishing existence by 1967 independently of the later copyright record.
Baker's Biographical Dictionary, hosted by Encyclopedia.com, dates the concerto 1965; use as a secondary date lead pending primary score confirmation.
